objective_value: <float> Total travel cost across all vehicles, including the per-vehicle fixed cost embedded in arcs leaving the origin depot.

routes.vehicle_id: <int> Identifier of the vehicle performing this route.
routes.route_sequence: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of nodes visited by the vehicle, starting at the origin depot and ending at the destination depot.

route_details.node_id: <int> Node visited at this step of the route.
route_details.arrival_time: <float> Time at which the vehicle begins service at this node.
route_details.load_after: <float> Quantity of goods on board the vehicle upon departing this node.
